cues.zh: 只是有人坐下來，想出一堆古怪點子，全部試過，再找出真正好用的。

cues.en: Again, I do not mean that in a dismissive or insulting way.
cues.zh: 同樣地，我不是在輕視或侮辱。

cues.en: Deep learning is a very new and very quickly developing field.
cues.zh: 深度學習是非常新、發展非常快速的領域。

cues.en: And so, like all the other new disciplines in science, it is very much based on empirical explorations.
cues.zh: 就像其他新的科學學科，很大程度仰賴實證探索。

cues.en: Basically just trying things to see what works and what doesn't.
cues.zh: 基本上，就是試試什麼有效、什麼無效。

cues.en: This second comment here, I've already said multiple times, but it really is the case that the mechanism
cues.zh: 第二點，我已說過好幾次，但注意力

cues.en: of attention and transformer language models is simply to add, subtract, and scale embeddings vectors as they are passed along the residual stream.
cues.zh: 與 Transformer 語言模型的機制，確實就是嵌入向量沿殘差流傳遞時，對它們加、減、縮放。

cues.en: Exactly like what we've been doing here in the past few videos, but just doing it more and in a more sophisticated way.
cues.zh: 就像前幾部影片一直做的，只是做更多次，而且方式更精密。
